choose.when: order by lower(s.site_name) asc,s.sort_order asc,s.id desc
order by lower(s.site_name) desc,s.sort_order asc,s.id desc
order by s.site_type asc,s.sort_order asc,s.id desc
order by s.site_type desc,s.sort_order asc,s.id desc
order by s.founded_period asc nulls last,s.sort_order asc,s.id desc
order by s.founded_period desc nulls last,s.sort_order asc,s.id desc
order by s.current_status asc nulls last,s.sort_order asc,s.id desc
order by s.current_status desc nulls last,s.sort_order asc,s.id desc
order by s.created_at asc,s.sort_order asc,s.id desc
order by s.created_at desc,s.sort_order asc,s.id desc
order by s.updated_at asc,s.sort_order asc,s.id desc
order by s.updated_at desc,s.sort_order asc,s.id desc

mapper.select: select s.* from culture_site s limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
